searchText: <mratsim> I’ve started the https://github.com/eth2-clients organization we’ve discussed with a couple of teams in devcon <mratsim> the ideas is that things that would be easier to update collaboratively like the “multinet” start scripts or the “chat app” to test our respective libp2p implementations go there <mratsim> everyone is admin, please invite your team members as well so that they can do PR. We will transfer the multinet scripts from our nim-beacon-chain repo to that org ASAP. <mratsim> Name of the organization can be changed to something more inspiring if you have ideas ;) <protolambda> Hagibis, lol <mratsim> Hagibis would be a testnet name before we take over the world by a storm ;) <mratsim> after the calm Muskoka :p <mratsim> I’m going to enjoy japan for the reminder of the week now :) Using "Muskoka" for a test service that's in the works. Got delayed a bit by devcon and new attestation aggregation ideas, but getting there <mratsim> I suppose that org can be where all clients put their xcli scripts for fuzzing as well Remainder for Muskoka is to fix test results pagination, and write dockerfiles for each of the client worker nodes (multi stage, wrapping the client cli with some instrumentation) <Daft-Wullie> is there a eth 2.0 implementers call planned for tomorrow?or postponed due to post-devcon decompression period? <Daft-Wullie> or for the day after tomorrow rather <Daft-Wullie> the 17th
